exposure: Antenatal testing methods (nonstress test, biophysical profile, amniotic fluid index, estimated fetal weight, Doppler ultrasound)
Findings altering management (abnormal EFW, Doppler ultrasound)
cohort: The study participants were maternal-fetal medicine (MFM) specialists from institutions affiliated with the North American Fetal Therapy Network (NAFTNet).
finding: Gastroschisis management practices differ among NAFTNet centers, although most MFM specialists initiate antenatal surveillance at 32 weeks, and there is no consensus on optimal timing of delivery.
cross-section timing: Practices reported in 2018 (survey administered for '2019' ID likely refers to publication year or data collection close to it).
gest_age: Antenatal testing beginning at 32 weeks, delivery at 37 weeks or 39 weeks.
